SOVEREIGN AI — SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT
Department: Executive & Strategy
Classification: Confidential
Document ID: ES-FIN-001
Effective Date: 2026-07-01

FINANCIAL RISK GUIDELINES

Purpose
These fictional guidelines define financial risk controls for testing the Executive & Strategy RAG search agent. All organizations, figures, thresholds, and policies in this document are synthetic.

Key risk thresholds
1. Liquidity risk: Escalate when the 30-day projected cash coverage falls below 1.5x committed operating expenses.
2. Customer concentration: Escalate when one customer represents more than 22% of annualized revenue.
3. Vendor concentration: Review when one critical vendor represents more than 35% of infrastructure spend.
4. Budget variance: A department must submit an explanation when quarterly operating expenditure is more than 8% above approved budget.
5. Capital expenditure: Executive approval is required for unplanned capital expenditure above $250,000.
6. Currency exposure: Treasury review is required when unhedged foreign-currency exposure exceeds $1.2 million equivalent.

Risk severity
Critical: Immediate executive notification and mitigation owner assigned within 4 hours.
High: Risk committee review within 1 business day.
Medium: Corrective action plan within 5 business days.
Low: Track in the monthly risk register.

Example
If projected 30-day cash coverage is 1.3x, the situation is below the 1.5x threshold and must be escalated as a liquidity risk.

Classification: Confidential
Document ID: ES-DEC-006
Meeting: Executive Risk Review — 2026-08-28

RECORDED DECISIONS

Decision 1
Project Sentinel may proceed to controlled pilot status. Production approval is blocked until model-change audit evidence is complete.

Decision 2
Platform Operations must submit a corrective action plan because Q2 spending was 8.75% above budget. The plan is due within 5 business days of the review.

Decision 3
The customer concentration risk at 24% is classified as High and remains open. Commercial Strategy must provide a diversification update at the next executive review.

Decision 4
Project Aurora remains a priority because disaster-recovery readiness is considered strategically important. The failover exercise target date is 2026-09-25.

Decision 5
No confidential dataset may be moved into a production AI workflow without an identified data owner and documented access controls.
